description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different large language models (LLMs) and their associated answer types across three distinct domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents popularity, scaled from 0 to 220, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain. For each domain, five different models or answer types are compared: Llama3 (blue, diagonal stripes), ChatGPT (red, horizontal stripes), Acc=0 & GT Ans (gray, solid), Acc=0 & Gene Ans (black, cross-hatch), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (yellow, vertical stripes). In the Movies category, Llama3 has the highest popularity, followed by ChatGPT, with the other categories showing significantly lower values. In the Songs category, Llama3 again leads, followed by ChatGPT, with the other categories showing lower popularity. In the Basketball category, ChatGPT has the highest popularity, followed by Llama3, with the other categories showing lower values. The chart shows that the popularity of LLMs and their answers varies significantly across different domains, with Llama3 and ChatGPT being the most popular in most cases.
